Forge Pro 1.0.1

Build 202608281455 · commit a0a440f · stable channel

  • docs: SSOT — Sol 1c landed, 1.0.1 staging
  • build(macOS): Sol pass 1c — the DMG archive lives outside the appcast's scanned dir; a changed Sparkle nested layout fails the cut instead of skipping the signing (GH #12)
  • docs: SSOT — Sol adjudication landed (6454448), 1.0.1 queued
  • fix(updates): Sol pass adjudication for GH #12/#423 — Swift package licenses in the notices (swift-markdown Apache-2.0 + NOTICE, swift-cmark BSD), notices bundled on iOS, the General 'Updates…' button routes the compact stack, Sparkle's own auto-check flips mirrored, the state adopts the persisted channel, the release cut refuses a non-increasing build number and feeds generate_appcast only the new DMG
  • docs: standalone log — GH #12/#423 run, attack list, Sol timeouts
  • docs: SSOT — Forge Pro 1.0.0 PUBLISHED, Prod on the feed, Sol passes in flight
  • build(macOS): release-macos.sh verifies the appcast item by ELEMENT and by the build number actually packaged (GH #12)
  • build(macOS): release-macos.sh — bash 3.2 empty-array expansion under set -u (killed the first cut after a successful notarization) (GH #12)
